institution: University of California at Los Angeles School of Dentistry
otherConditions: Minimum 90 semester units (135 quarter units) required, typically over 3-4 years. All required courses must be passed with a grade of C or higher and completed no later than June 30 of the year admission is sought. Accredited community college coursework accepted but limited to 70 semester/105 quarter units; online classes not accepted.

institution: Texas Tech University Health Sciences Center El Paso
otherConditions: All prerequisites must be completed with a grade of C or better at a regionally accredited US or Canadian institution; Pass/Fail or Credit/No Credit grading does not count. Foreign coursework does not count even if transfer credit was granted by a US/Canadian school.

courses.name: Biological Science
courses.details: 12 semester hours lecture plus 2 semester hours formal lab.

courses.name: Microbiology
courses.details: Separate from, and in addition to, the 14-hour Biological Science requirement.

institution: University of Nevada Las Vegas School of Dental Medicine
otherConditions: All prerequisite courses and units must be completed by July of the intended enrollment year, though completing them before application/DAT is highly recommended. Transcripts must be submitted from all institutions attended as part of AADSAS, and again prior to matriculation to verify prerequisites and degree completion.

institution: University at Buffalo School of Dental Medicine
otherConditions: Minimum 60 credit hours (two full years) of study required at an accredited US or Canadian institution prior to application. Prerequisite courses must be completed within 5 years of applying and fully completed before the first day of dental school. Online prerequisite courses are strongly discouraged.
